CLIP (with atom IDs): E06.019 | 00:36.00-00:39.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Mara toward Tobin.
E06.020 | 00:36.40-00:38.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (urgent, kind) | "I saw who slipped the ring into your shawl."
E06.021 | 00:39.00-00:44.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E06.022 | 00:39.40-00:42.82 | DLG | SELENE (sweet, panicked) | "Smile, sister. It is your last night of freedom."
E06.023 | 00:44.00-00:47.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of the Mayor and Mara, the space between them charged.
E06.024 | 00:44.40-00:46.80 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (cold, nervous) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
E06.025 | 00:47.00-00:52.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E06.026 | 00:47.40-00:50.44 | DLG | MARA (furious, broken) | "I kept that light burning for eleven winters."
E06.027 | 00:52.00-00:56.00 | CAM | Low angle on the Mayor framed against the lighthouse beam.
E06.028 | 00:52.40-00:55.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, venomous) | "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
E06.029 | 00:56.00-00:59.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E06.030 | 00:56.40-00:58.80 | DLG | MARA (furious, hopeful) | "Tell me the truth, or tell me nothing."
E06.031 | 00:59.00-01:05.00 | CAM | Low angle on Tobin framed against the lighthouse beam.
E06.032 | 00:59.40-01:02.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (furious, cold) | "Expose me and her father hangs beside me."
E06.033 | 01:05.00-01:08.00 | CAM | Low angle on Selene framed against the lighthouse beam.
E06.034 | 01:08.00-01:13.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E06.035 | 01:08.40-01:12.58 | DLG | CORIN (dry, earnest) | "Marry me at dawn, and no one will dare touch you."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
